data.name: Maimunah
data.gender_notes: Maimunah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'm-m-n', meaning 'to protect, guard, or safeguard'. In Islamic tradition, Maimunah refers to a woman who is cherished, loved, and protected. The name Maimunah carries the meaning “Guarded, Protected” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maimunah usually hope their child will grow to embody guarded, protected and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the idea of being shielded from harm and guided towards prosperity
data.etymology: Maimunah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guarded, Protected.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maimunah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: ميمونة
in_arabic.long_meaning: ميمونة هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة 'ميمون' التي تعني السعيد أو المبارك. في اللغة العربية، يعني الاسم الحظ السعيد أو الخير الكثير. وفي سياق تاريخي، كانت ميمونة بنت الحارس زوجة للنبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، مما يجعل الاسم ذا أهمية دينية وروحانية كبيرة في الإسلام.

in_urdu.name: میمونہ
in_urdu.meaning: میمونہ یعنی خوش قسمت، مبارک اور خوشحال
in_urdu.long_meaning: میمونہ ایک عربی मूल کا مؤنث نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوش قسمت یا مبارک۔ یہ نام 'میمون' سے ماخوذ ہے جو کہ سعادت یا برکت کے معنی رکھتا ہے۔ اسلامی تاریخ میں، ميمونة بنت الحارس نبی محمد صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کی زوجہ تھیں، جس سے یہ نام اسلامی روایت میں خاصا اہم ہو جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मैमunah
in_hindi.meaning: मैमunah का अर्थ है सुखी, مبارक और भाग्यशाली
in_hindi.long_meaning: मैमunah एक अरबी मूल का स्त्रीलिंग नाम है, जिसका अर्थ है सुखी या مبارक। यह नाम 'میمون' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है सौभाग्यशाली या समृद्धि। इस्लामिक परंपरा में, मिमूना बिन्त अल-हरिस नेवी मुहम्मद सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम की पत्नी थीं, जो इस नाम को विशेष आध्यात्मिक महत्व देती है।

in_pashto.name: مېمونې
in_pashto.meaning: مېمونې معنی یې داده خوشحاله، مبارکه او خوش قسمته
in_pashto.long_meaning: مېمونې د عربي اصل يو ښځينه نوم دی، چې معنی یې خوشحاله یا مبارک دی. دا نوم د 'ميمون' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د خوښۍ یا برکت معنی لري. په اسلامي تاريخ کې، ميمونة بنت الحارس د پيغمبر محمد صلی الله عليه وسلم يوې ښځې وې، نو دا نوم په اسلامي روايت کې ډېر اهم دی.

in_english.name: Maimunah
in_english.meaning: Maimunah means blessed, happy, and fortunate
in_english.long_meaning: Maimunah is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the word 'Maimun' which means blessed, happy, or fortunate. In Islamic tradition, Maimunah bint al-Haris was a wife of the Prophet Muhammad, making the name significant in Islamic history and spirituality. It symbolizes good fortune, prosperity, and divine blessings.

In a patriarchal society like the Islamic world, a name that signifies the respect and cherishing of women is highly important. It reflects the Islamic belief in female dignity and their role in society. This name is a reminder to men to always protect and cherish their wives, and for women to be cherished and loved.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Maimunah is a reminder of Allah's protection and care for His creation, specifically for women. It represents the idea of Allah being the ultimate Protector and Guardian of all beings. By giving a child the name Maimunah, parents are prayerfully asking for Allah's protection and blessings for their child. It is a constant reminder of the spiritual bond between the child, their parents, and Allah.
